CFML Language Reference: Functions

IsK2ServerDocCountExceeded

Returns YES when the documents indexed in the K2 Server's collections exceed the limit returned by GetK2ServerDocCountLimit. Indexing pages can check it before adding more documents.

Category

System functions

Syntax

IsK2ServerDocCountExceeded()

Returns

YES or NO.

Usage

Note  The Verity K2 Server functions belong to the K2 Server support that shipped with the next major version; KoldFusion provides them so pages written for it run here too.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFIF IsK2ServerDocCountExceeded()>
  <P><B>The Verity K2 Server is over its document limit.</B> Purge or delete a collection.</P>
<CFELSE>
  <CFOUTPUT><P>Room for #NumberFormat(GetK2ServerDocCountLimit() - GetK2ServerDocCount())# more documents.</P></CFOUTPUT>
</CFIF>

See also

GetK2ServerDocCount, GetK2ServerDocCountLimit, CFINDEX
